configuration.name: Action rock
configuration.lineage: Scandinavian high-energy rock-and-roll and garage-punk continuum, represented by the Swedish Hellacopters. The action-rock label foregrounds immediate riff attack, melodic guitar leads and a driving band backbeat. This contemporary studio model selects the guitar-bass-drums core rather than prescribing every keyboard or percussion overdub heard across the repertoire.

entries.axis_rationale: Authored ordinal estimates of this selected arrangement; no tempo, loudness, studio measurement or physiological observation inferred from the coordinates.

nearest_neighbor_distinctions.reason: Garage rock uses the catalog’s 1960s single-coil-and-organ ensemble; this action-rock model uses a humbucker lead, no organ, sticks_punk, and modern digital tracking.
Hard rock retains a broader classic blues-metal foundation; this model pins overdriven lead, punk attack and doubled rough sung voice with a compact core.

geo.rationale: Artist/label cultural location, not exclusive genre birthplace.

configuration.name: Alternative metal
configuration.lineage: Late-1980s onward metal and alternative-rock crossover, represented here by Faith No More and the 1989 album The Real Thing. Heavy guitar riffing shares the arrangement with a rhythmically active bass, keyboards and an elastic sung vocal. The selected model emphasizes contrasts of riff, keyboard color and vocal register; funk bass and rap delivery are possible influences, not requirements of the entire genre.

entries.axis_rationale: Authored ordinal estimates of this selected arrangement; no tempo, loudness, studio measurement or physiological observation inferred from the coordinates.

nearest_neighbor_distinctions.reason: Funk metal pins slap_pop; this model selects fingerstyle_locked, register_break_voice, octave vocal doubling and a keyboard pad, allowing funk influence without making slap technique obligatory.
Speed metal centers fast heavy-metal attack and a belt voice; this model selects drop-D muted guitar, register shifts and keyboard color with less continuous pulse in the authored axes.

geo.rationale: Studio D, Sausalito is the documented recording anchor, not an exclusive origin.

configuration.name: Black speed metal
configuration.lineage: Black-metal and speed/thrash-metal intersection represented by the Scottish solo recording project Hellripper, whose own account identifies black/speed metal and documents DIY recording of Coagulating Darkness in 2016-2017. Fast riffs, active lead guitar and harsh vocal attack retain the forward motion and compact song orientation of speed metal. The modern chain below is a reproducible authored model, not the equipment of that session.

entries.axis_rationale: Authored ordinal estimates of this selected arrangement; no tempo, loudness, studio measurement or physiological observation inferred from the coordinates.

nearest_neighbor_distinctions.reason: Speed metal pins a full_chest_belt_voice and muted guitar; this model selects worn_fold_voice with tube saturation and tremolo-picked guitar.

Black metal is the broader lineage. This selected speed-facing model has a tight dry modern chain, explicitly pinned compact ensemble and DIY-project cultural anchor; it does not require ambient form or the original catalog’s basement cassette model.

geo.rationale: Artist release tags Aberdeen and Scotland; marker is a selected cultural anchor for a geographically mobile solo project.

sources.title: Cult of Luna — Pelagic Records
sources.support: Band-associated label page identifies Vertikal/Vertikal II and Metropolis concept, contrasted quiet soundtrack work. This page is not evidence Pelagic released every cited album.

configuration.name: Atmospheric post-metal
configuration.lineage: Atmosphere-centered strand of post-metal represented by Cult of Luna, extending heavy guitar-bass-drums writing with keyboards, long dynamic arcs and passages of reduced density. The Long Road North documents an Umeå-centered recording and writing practice. This selected arrangement places clean arpeggiation and sustained electronic texture beside distorted peaks and a textural harsh vocal, rather than treating the label as a separate universal origin story.

entries.axis_rationale: Authored ordinal estimates of this selected arrangement; no tempo, loudness, studio measurement or physiological observation inferred from the coordinates.

nearest_neighbor_distinctions.reason: Generic post-metal has no synth card and pins power_chord guitar; this model adds analog_synth pad, triangle oscillator, svf filter, pad envelope and clean arpeggiation with delay/hall space.

Atmospheric black metal pins a harsh tremolo/blast-oriented band configuration. This model focuses a post-metal dynamic arc, clean arpeggiation, keyboard sustain and reduced vocal foreground rather than continuous black-metal riffing.

geo.rationale: Umeå is documented as a writing and principal recording locus on the label biography, not sole origin.

configuration.name: Ambient black metal
configuration.lineage: Ambient and black-metal intersection represented by the Swiss trio Darkspace, founded in Berne in 1999; its 2003 debut Dark Space I combines heavy guitar with electronic samples and extended immersive pieces. This configuration models a drone-and-sample-dominant passage with guitar, bass and distant harsh voice. It omits a percussion card for that passage without claiming the wider recordings are beatless.

entries.axis_rationale: Authored ordinal estimates of this selected arrangement; no tempo, loudness, studio measurement or physiological observation inferred from the coordinates.

nearest_neighbor_distinctions.reason: Atmospheric black metal has a drum-kit card and no sampler; this selected ambient passage adds sampler_classic loop layering and feedback guitar with no percussion card. The beatless selection is passage-specific.
Dark ambient omits electric guitar/bass and favors electronic/ritual resonances. This model retains amplified guitar mass, electric bass and a distant harsh voice alongside the sampler.

geo.rationale: Artist/label cultural location, not exclusive genre birthplace.
